reason: I've never seen anyone on TikTok unbox something from Baghdad Express and none of my friends have used it, so I'm not sending money up front to a page I don't know. The Instagram page I already order from gets me similar stuff and I'm used to them.
objection: Paying for the item before it ships, then waiting 2 to 3 weeks with no way to return it if I just don't like it. 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes also feels like a lot when my usual page doesn't break it down like that.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real unboxing video from someone I follow, or a friend ordering first and showing me it arrived like the photo.
